script: jungle temples and swamp huts spawn at a random Y level and
move to the surface when asked to place blocks in the world.
this is problematic because their bounding box when checking
for collisions is not guaranteed to be the same as their bounding
box after that movement. as such, they can collide with other
structures when they're not supposed to. the workaround here
is to move the structure in an overrider, before collisions
are checked, and hope that the final bounding box is close enough
that there aren't any false negatives caused by movement.
